sources.label: Official Topshop size guide, numeric (product-page Size Guide on topshop.com, Body Measurements cm + International Conversions)
Official Topshop size guide, letter sizes XS–XL (product-page Size Guide on topshop.com)

audit: Old source was ASOS's Topshop brand page; Topshop now has its own site again (topshop.com, run by ASOS) with a product-page Size Guide. Numeric chart UK 4-18 (single cm values); letter chart gives XS = UK 4-6, S = 8-10, M = 12-14, L = 16-18, XL = 20-22, and its ranges match the numeric rows exactly, so letters are kept as altLabel and XL (UK 20-22) is added from the letter chart. The stored letter-to-UK mapping was wrong (M was UK 12 only, S UK 8-10 single values). UK 12 bust 90 -> 93, waist 70 -> 75, hips 95 -> 100; UK 16 bust 102 -> 103, waist 82 -> 85, hips 107 -> 110; UK 18 bust 108 -> 110, waist 88 -> 92, hips 113 -> 117. US/EU from the same guide's conversions.
notes: Formerly UK high-street giant, now online-only via its own site (topshop.com, run by ASOS) and ASOS. UK sizing 4–18, letter sizes XS–XL (XL = UK 20–22). Body-conscious, trend-led cuts. One of the most common brands found second-hand. Denim (Joni, Jamie) runs 1 size small in waist.
